अती (√ इ) cl. 2. P. अत्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to pass by, elapse, pass over, overflow; to pass on; to get over; (Ved. Inf. अत्य्-एतवै), to pass through, RV. v, 83, 10; to defer; to enter; to overcome, overtake, outdo; to pass by, neglect; to overstep, violate; to be redundant; to die: Intens. अतीयते, to overcome.
a: अती — [अति-इ] {c2c} P. 1 To go beyond, pass on, over or beyond, cross (time or space); स्तोकमंतरमतीत्य Ś. 1; जवादतीये हिमवानधोमुखैः Ki. 14. 54 was gone to or reached; स्थातव्यं ते नयनविषयं यावदत्येति भानुः Me. 34 passes out of sight; अतीत्यैकादशाहं तु नामकर्म तथाऽकरोत् Rām. after 11 days; गृहपंक्तयश्चिरमतीयिरे जनैः Śi. 13. 53. --2 To enter, step over; अद्वारेण च नातीयात् ग्रामं वा वेश्म वा वृतं Ms. 4. 73. --3 To excel, surpass, outstrip, be more than a match for; त्रिस्रोतसः कांतिमतीत्य तस्थौ Ku. 7. 15; सत्यमतीत्य हरितो हरींश्च वर्तंते वाजिनः Ś. 1; अग्निस्त्विषा नात्येति पूषणं Śi. 2. 23; to exceed, go beyond, transcend; कुसीदवृद्धिर्द्वैगुण्यं नात्येति Ms. 8. 151 does not exceed; अतीत्य वाचां मनसां च गोचरं स्थिताय Ki. 18. 41, Śi. 16. 48. --4 To overcome, subdue, vanquish, get the better of; न प्रदीप इव वायुमत्यगात् R. 19. 53 did not overcome, outlive or survive; to overtake, outdo. --5 To walk by, walk past, pass by, leave behind; स्रोतोवहां पथि निकामजलामतीत्य Ś. 6. 16; सोत्यगात् आश्रमं R. 15. 37. --6 To omit, neglect, disregard, violate, transgress, overstep; न दिष्टमर्थमत्येतुमीशो मर्त्यः कथंचन Mb. avoid; अतीत्य हि गुणान् सर्वान् स्वभावो मूर्ध्नि वर्तते H. 1. 15; देशं कालं च योऽ तीयात् Y. 2. 195; अतीयात्सागरो वेलां न प्रतिज्ञामहं पितुः Rām.; भूतान्यत्येति पंच वै Ms. 12. 90 oversteps the five elements (मोक्षं प्राप्नोति Kull.); अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा Bg. 8. 28, 14. 20. --7 (Intrans.) To pass, elapse (time); अत्येति रजनी या तु सा न प्रतिनिवर्तते Rām.; अतीते दक्षिणायने &c. --8 To overflow, be redundant, be in excess. --9 To die.

[इदं-तसिल्] 1 Than this; from this (having a comparative force); अतो देवा अवंतु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे Rv. 1. 22. 16; किमु परमतो नर्तयसि मां Bh. 3. 6; अतोऽन्यथा Ms. 5. 31. --2 From this or that cause, hence, consequently, so, therefore (corr. to यत्, यस्मात् or हि, expressed or understood); अंतर्गतं प्राणभृतां हि वेद सर्वं भवान्भावमतोभिधास्ये R. 2. 43, 3. 50, Ku. 2. 5; अथातो ब्रह्मजिज्ञासा Ś. B. now therefore &c. --3 Hence, from this place; henceforth (of time or place); (-परं, -ऊर्ध्वं), afterwards. --4 Then (corr. of यदि-यद्). --Comp. --अर्थं --निमित्तं on this account, hence, for this reason. --एव for this very reason. --ऊर्ध्वं henceforth; afterwards. --परं (a) further on, any longer (with abl.); hereafter; निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत उर्ध्वं Bg. 12. 8. (b) beyond this, further than this; भाग्यायत्तमतःपरं Ś. 4. 16 more than this; अतःपरं नास्ति ममोत्तरं V. 2 now I have nothing more to say; (c) afterwards.

m: अति ind. [probably neut. of an obsolete adj. अतिन्, passing, going, beyond; see √ अत्, and cf. Old Germ. anti, unti, inti, unde, indi, &c.; Eng. and; Germ. und; Gk. ἔτι, ἀντί, Lat. ante; Lith. ant; Arm. ti; Zend aitì].

As a prefix to verbs and their derivatives, expresses beyond, over, and, if not standing by itself, leaves the accent on the verb or its derivative; as, अति-क्रम् (√ क्रम्), to overstep, Ved. Inf. अति-क्रमे, (fit) to be walked on, to be passed, RV. i, 105, 16, अति-क्रमण n. See s.v. When prefixed to nouns, not derived from verbs, it expresses beyond, surpassing, as, अति-कश, past the whip, अति-मानुष, superhuman, &c. See s.v.
As a separable adverb or preposition (with acc.), Ved. beyond (with gen.) over, at the top of RV.; AV.
is often prefixed to nouns and adjectives, and rarely to verbs, in the sense excessive, extraordinary, intense;
excessively, too
exceedingly, very
in such compounds the accent is generally on अति.
a: अति — ind. [अत्-इ] 1 A prefix used with adjectives and adverbs, meaning ‘very’, ‘too’, ‘exceedingly’, ‘excessively’, ‘very much,’ and showing उत्कर्ष; नातिदूरे not very far from; ˚कृश very lean; ˚भृशं very much; also with verbs or verbal forms; ˚सिक्तमेव भवता Sk.; स्वभावो ह्यतिरिच्यते &c. --2 (With verbs) Over, beyond; अति-इ go beyond, overstep; so ˚क्रम्, ˚चर्, ˚वह् &c. In this case अति is regarded as a preposition उपसर्ग. --3 (a) (With nouns or pronouns) Beyond, past, surpassing, superior to, eminent, respectable, distinguished, higher, above, (used with acc. as a कर्मप्रवचनीय, or as first member of Bah. or Tat. Comp.; in which last case it has usually the sense of eminence or higher degree: अतिगो, ˚गार्ग्यः, = प्रशस्ता गौः, शोभनो, गार्ग्यः; ˚राजन् an excellent king; or the sense of अतिक्रांत must be understood with the latter member which will then stand in the accusative case; अतिमर्त्यः = मर्त्यमतिक्रांतः; ˚मालः, अतिक्रांतो मालां; so अतिकाय, ˚केशर, q. v.); अति देवान् कृष्णः Sk.; मानुषानतिगंधर्वान् सर्वान्गंधर्व लक्षये Mb; ˚मानुषं कर्म a deed which is beyond human power, i. e. a superhuman action; ˚कशः past the whip (as a horse), unmanageable; ˚त्यद् surpassing that; ˚त्वां, ˚त्वान् him or them that surpasses or surpass thee, so ˚मां, ˚यूयं &c. (b) (With nouns derived from roots) Extravagant, exaggerated, inordinate, excessive, extraordinary; e. g. ˚आदरः excessive regard; ˚आशा extravagant hope; so ˚भयं, ˚तृष्णा, ˚आनंदः &c. &c.; अतिदानात् बलिर्बद्धो नष्टो मानात्सुयोधनः . विनष्टो रावणो लौल्यादति सर्वत्र वर्जयेत्; cf. ‘extremes are ever bad.’ (c) Unfit, idle, improper, in the sense of असंप्रति or क्षेप ‘censure’; अतिनिद्रं = निद्रा संप्रति न युज्यते Sk. The गणरत्नमहोदधि gives the following senses of अतिः - विक्रमातिक्रमाबुद्धिभृशार्थातिशयेष्वति . e. g. अतिरथः रथाधिकं विक्रमवान्; ˚मतिः बुद्ध्यतिक्रमः; ˚गहनं बुद्धेरविषयः; ˚तप्तं भृशतप्तं; ˚वेगः अतिशयितो वेगः.

a: अतिथिः — [अतति गच्छति न तिष्ठति; अत्-इथिन् Uṇ. 4. 2; lit. a ‘traveller’; according to Manu एकरात्रं तु निवसन्नतिथिर्व्राह्मणः स्मृतः . अनित्यं हि स्थितो यस्मात्तस्मादतिथिरुच्यते 3. 112] 1 A guest (fig. also); अतिथिनेव निवेदितं Ś. 4; कुसुमलताप्रियातिथे Ś. 6 dear or welcome guest; पुरंदरपुरातिथिषु पितृषु Dk. 2 the guests of Indra's capital i. e. dead; so समरे यमनगरातिथिरकारि 12; धन्यानां श्रवणपथातिथित्वमेति (उक्तं) Ratn. 2. 7 becomes a guest of, i. e. goes to or falls on the ears of the fortunate only; करोति ते मुखं तन्वि चपेटापातनातिथिं K. P. --2 Wrath. --3 N. of a son of Kuśa and Kumudavatī and grandson. of Rāma. --Comp. --क्रिया --पूजा, --सत्कारः --सत्क्रिया, --सेवा hospitable reception of guests, rite of hospitality, hospitality, attention to the guests. --देव a. [ अतिथिर्देव इव पूज्यो यस्य] treating the guest as a God. --धर्मः title or claim to hospitality; hospitality due to guests; गृह्यतां ˚र्मः Pt. 1; यदि त्वतिथिधर्मेण क्षत्रियो गृहमाव्रजेत् Ms. 3. 111 should come as a guest. --धर्मिन् a. entitled to hospitality as a guest Ms. 3. 112. --पतिः the host or entertainer.

See R. 11. 9 also. --3 N. of one of Dakṣa's daughters.

m: अति-देश m. transfer, extended application, inference, analogy, overruling influence, assimilation
a rule providing for more than the usual rule
putting one thing instead of another, substitution
रूपातिदेश, such a rule as affecting the form of a word
अति-देश mfn. overruling, previously stated.
a: अतिदेशः — 1 Transfer, making over, assigning. --2 (Gram.) Extended application, application by analogy, transference of one attribute to another, attraction of one case or rule to another; अतिदेशो नाम इतरधर्मस्य इतरस्मिन् प्रयोगाय आदेशः ( मीमांसा); or अन्यत्रैव प्रणीतायाः कृत्स्नाया धर्मसंहतेः . अन्यत्र कार्यतः प्राप्तिरतिदेशः स उच्यते.. प्राकृतात् कर्मणो यस्मात्तत्समानेषु कर्मसु . धर्मप्रवेशो येन स्यादतिदेशः स उच्यते .. This अतिदेश is of 5 kinds: शास्त्र˚, कार्य˚, निमित्त˚, व्यपदेश˚ & रूप˚. Thus in Grammar प्रकृतिवत् विकृतिः, कर्मणा कर्मवत्तुल्यक्रियः or पुंवत्, णिद्वत्, व्यपदेशीवद्भावः & इण्वदिकः are instances. गोसदृशो गवयः is an instance of रूपातिदेश or analogy; वाक्यार्थस्यातिदेशस्य स्मृतिर्व्यापार उच्यते Bhāṣā P. 80. अतिदेश is generally expressed by words showing likeness or resemblance, such as इव, वत्, सदृश &c.

m: अति—गण्ड mfn. having large cheeks or temples

m: अति—गन्ध mfn. having an overpowering smell

lemongrass (Andropogon Schaenunthes)
the Champac flower (Michelia Champaca)
a kind of jasmin.

अति-गरियसा (instr.) √ क्री, to buy too dear, Daś.
अति-√ गर्ज् to speak loudly or provokingly or in a threatening voice, MBh.

being past.

m: अति-गव mfn. (a bull) covering the cow, L.
a: अतिगव — a. [अतिक्रांतो गां] 1 Very foolish, quite stupid. --2 Inexpressible, indescribable.

m: अति—गो f. an excellent cow, Pāṇ. v, 4, 69, Sch.

अति-ग्राह m. the object of a ग्रह (q.v.) or organ of apprehension (these are eight, and their corresponding अति-ग्रहस् or objects, are अपान, ‘fragrant substance’; नामन् ‘name’; रस ‘flavour’; रूप ‘form’; सब्द ‘sound’; काम ‘desire’; कर्मन् ‘action’; स्पर्श ‘touch’), ŚBr. xiv.
अति-ग्राह्य m. N. of three successive libations made, (or cups filled) at the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice, TS.; ŚBr. &c.
a: अतिग्राह्य — a. To be held in check, to be controlled. --ह्यः N. of three libations made at the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice.

m: अति-√ ग्रह् to take beyond or over the usual measure, ŚBr.; TBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; to surpass, Pāṇ. v, 4, 46, Sch.
a: अतिग्रह् — {c9c} P. To take beyond the usual measure.

v: tri॰ atiSayitaH graho jYAnaM, svasvakAryyasya grahaRaM vA yezAm । svasvavizayagrAhakezu netrAdizu jYAnendriyezu, AdAnAdisvasvakAryyakArakezu vAgAdizu karmmendriyezu ca । atikrAnto graham । atyantadurboDe tri॰ । atiSayito graho jYAnam । sarvvaTA samyagjYAne pu॰ । atigrahaRAdayo'pyuktArTezu ।
m: अति-ग्रह m. act of taking over or beyond surpassing, one who takes or seizes to an extraordinary extent, (in phil.) = अतिग्राह.
a: अतिग्रह — a. [अतिक्रांतो ग्रहं] Difficult to be comprehended, incomprehensible. --हः, --ग्राहः 1 Object of an apprehensive organ, such as स्पर्श ‘touch’ the object of त्वच्, रस of जिह्वा &c. The Grahas are eight in number; प्राण, वाच्, जिह्वा, चक्षुस्, श्रोत्र, मनस्, हस्तौ & त्वच्; the corresponding atigrāhas being अपान, नामन्, रस, रूप, शब्द, काम, कर्मन् & स्पर्श. --2 Right knowledge, correct apprehension. --3 Act of overtaking, surpassing &c. --4 One who seizes or takes to a very great extent.

a: अतिगुण — a. 1 Having excellent or superior qualities. --2 Devoid of merits, worthless [गुणमतिक्रांतः]. --णः Excellent merits.

a: अतिगुहा — [अतिक्रांता गुहां मध्यावकाशेन] N. of the plant पृश्निपर्णी.

m: अति—गुप्त mfn. closely concealed, very mysterious.
अति-√ गुर् (Pot. अति जुगुर्यात्), to cry out, give a shriek, RV. i, 173, 2.

v: pu॰ atiSayito guruH pUjyatamatvAt prA॰ sa॰ । “trayaH puruzasyAtiguravo Bavanti pitA mAtAcAryyaSceti” vizRUkte pitrAdO । atyantagurutvavati pAradAdO dravye tri॰ । striyAM vA NIp । atigurvI ।

a: अतिगुरु — a. Very heavy (such as mercury &c.). --रुः A very respectable person, such as a father, mother &c. (त्रयः पुरुषस्य अतिगुरवो भवंति पिता माता आचार्यश्च).

m: अति-√ 2. हा to jump over, RV. &c.; to pass jumping from one place to another.
अति-हार m. addition, SaṃhUp.

a: अतिहस्तयति — Den. P. [अतिहस्त-णि] 1 To stretch out the hands (हस्तौ निरस्यति). --2 [हस्तिना अतिक्रामति] To overtake (one) on an elephant.

past the cold.

अति—ह्रस्व (अति-) mfn. excessively short, VS. &c.
अति-√ ह्वे (1. sg. Ā. -ह्वये), to call over to one's side, TBr.

अति-कथ mfn. transgressing tradition or law, deviating from the rules of caste (see also s.v. अति.)

अति-कल्याण mf(ई)n. ‘past or beyond beauty’, not beautiful, ŚBr.
अति—कल्यम् ind. very early, too early.

m: अति—कृश (अति-), mfn. very thin, emaciated.

अतिकृच्छ्र mfn. (said of Viṣṇu), MBh.

अति-कृतार्थ mfn. very clever or skilful, MBh.

m: अति—कृत mfn. over done, exaggerated.

v: strI ati + kf--ktin । maryyAtikrameRa karaRe । atyA॰ sa॰ । vfttaratnAkarokte “taTAtikftirutkftiriti” paYcaviMSatyakzarapAdake varRRavfttaBede ।

अति-कृति f. excess, Veṇīs.

अति—कृष्ण (अति-), mfn. very or too dark, very or too deep blue.
अति—किरिट (अति-) or अति—किरीट [Comm.], mfn. having too small teeth, TBr.

a: अतिक्रांत — p. p. 1 Exceeded, surpassed, gone beyond &c.; सोतिक्रांतः श्रवणविषयं Me. 103; सुदूरमतिक्रांतः K. 35 departed, gone; मनोरथ ˚दर्शना Māl. 10 beyond the reach even of desire; विचारातिक्रांतः Mu. 5. 4 past the stage of thought; चक्षुर्विषयातिक्रांतेषु पक्षिषु H. 1. --2 Past, gone by; ˚कुनृपति K. 5, past, former; 169. Pt. 1. 333, Pt. 2, Bh. 3. 32; ˚पार्थिवगुणान् Mu. 1 former kings. --तं A past thing, a thing of the past, the past; ˚तं भगवती कथयति M. 5 your ladyship is speaking of the past; ˚ते धैर्यमवलंब्यताम् U. 3; किं ˚उपालंभेन H. 1; cf. ‘let bygones be bygones.’ ˚योगिन् a. with the moon in conjunction.

m: अति-क्रामक mfn. exceeding, transgressing, L.
अति-क्रान्तातिक्रान्त mfn. one who has crossed the stream of sorrow, Divyāv.

m: अति-√ क्रम् to step or go beyond or over or across, (Ved. Inf. अति-क्रमे, to be walked on RV. i, 105, 16); to pass, cross; to pass time; to surpass, excel, overcome; to pass by, neglect; to overstep, transgress, violate; to pass on or away; to step out; to part from, lose: Caus. -क्रामयति, or -क्रमयति, to allow to pass (as time); to leave unnoticed.
a: अतिक्रम् — {c1c} U., {c4c} P. 1 (a) To step or pass beyond, get across, go over, cross; यत्कथयितुं प्रवृत्तस्तत्परित्यज्य अतिदूरमतिक्रांतोस्मि K. 346 led far away from my story, rambled, made a great digression; सप्त कक्षांतराण्यतिक्रम्य 92; निमिषमात्रेणातिदूरमतिक्रामति 120; समीपेप्यतिक्रामंती M. 1 going so near; अतिक्रम्य तांस्तान्विशेषान् Me. 57. (b) To pass over, pass by, walk past, go beyond; सेनानिवेशदेशमतिक्रम्य Dk. 4, 10; कथमतिक्रांतमगस्त्याश्रमपदं Mv. 7 is it passed or left behind; तस्मिन्नतिक्रामति Ś. 7. 31 इदं कदलीगृहमतिक्रम्य दृश्यते Ratn. 3 beyond the plantain-bower; तच्चातिक्रम्य कैलासगिरिः K. 121; जंबुद्वीपमतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः Rām.; अतिक्रामत्ययं K. 85 is going or departing. --2 To excel, surpass; exceed (in number, strength &c.); इरावतीमतिक्रामंती भव M. 4; अतिक्रामंतीमिवेरावतीं प्रेक्षे M. 1; वृद्धिर्नातिक्रामति पंचतां Ms. 8. 151; कर्णीसुतमप्यतिक्रांतः Dk. 74; कलासु रूपे चाप्सरसोप्यतिक्रांता 78 surpassing, superior to; शक्तिमनतिक्रम्य = यथाशक्ति Sk. --3 To transgress, violate, go beyond, overstep; जनकाग्रजन्मनोः शासनमतिक्रम्य Dk. 2; नालं पुरुषो नियतिलिखितां लेखामतिक्रमितुं 61; एवमतिक्रातमर्यादे त्वयि Ve. 1, Ms. 9. 78; अये वात्सल्यादतिक्रामति प्रसंगः Māl. 6 Oh, the event through excessive affection transgresses all due limits; अतिक्रम्य सदाचारं K. 160, 181. --4 To exclude, pass by, neglect, set aside, leave; किंवा परिजनमतिक्रम्य भवान् संदिष्टः M. 4; प्रथितयशसां प्रबंधानतिक्रम्य M. 1 to the exclusion of. --5 To go or pass away, elapse, roll on (as time); सा निशा अतिचक्राम Pt. 1; यथा यथा यौवनमतिचक्राम K. 59; शैशवं 74; भवतामप्यतिक्रामति देवार्चनविधिवेला 47 is passing away (is being violated).; अतिक्रांते दशाहे Ms. 5. 76; also trans. allow to pass; द्वित्राणि दिनान्यतिक्रम्य Dk. 100; अत्यक्राममिमान्मासांस्तद्वधं परिचिंतयन् Rām.; नाहारवेलातिक्रमणीया K. 266. --6 To overcome, overpower, seize; व्यालद्विप इवास्माभिरतिक्रम्यैव दम्यसे Mv. 3. 31 by seizing or falling upon, by main force; केनापि सत्त्वेन अतिक्रम्य Ś. 6. --7 To lose; स हि स्वाम्यादतिक्रामेत् ऋतूनां प्रतिरोधनात् Ms. 9. 93 --Caus. To let pass, allow to go.

v: tri॰ atiSayena muktaH videhakEvalyaM gataH ati + muca--karttari kta । nirvvARamuktimati । atikrAnto muktAM SOBryAt atyA॰ sa॰ । mADavIlatAyAM, tiniSavfkze ca pu॰ ।
m: अति—मुक्त mfn. entirely liberated
quite free from sensual or worldly desire
seedless, barren
अति—मुक्त m. the tree Dalbergia Oujeinensis
Gaertnera Racemosa,
अति-मुक्त or अति-मुक्तक, अस्, m. ‘surpassing pearls in whiteness’, N. of certain shrubs.
a: अतिमुक्त — a. 1 Entirely free from worldly desires, finally emancipated. --2 Barren, seedless. --3 Surpassing (a necklace of) pearls; अतिमुक्तमद्ग्रथितकेसरावली Māl. 5. 8. --क्तः --क्तकः 1 A kind of creeper (माधवी, Mar. कुसरी or कस्तुरमोगरा) represented as twisting itself round the mangotree and as the beloved of that tree; cf. क इदानीं सहकारमंतरेणातिमुक्तलतां पल्लवितां सहते Ś. 3, परिगृहाण गते सहकारतां त्वमतिमुक्तलताचरितं मयि M. 4. 13. --2 N. of a tree, Dalbergia Oujeinensis (तिनिश). --3 (˚क्तकः) Mountain ebony; N. of a tree called हरिमंथ (तिंदुकवृक्ष, तालवृक्ष also).

k.v: अतिमुक्तः पुण्ड्रकः स्याद्वासन्ती माधवी लता। सुमना मालती जातिः सप्तला नवमालिका॥

s: puM, (muc + BAve kta, AtaSayena muktaM banDaSETilyaM yasya saH bahuvrIhiH, kap .) tiniSavfkzaH । ityamaraH ॥ tindukavfkzaH । puzpavfkzaviSezaH । tatparyyAyaH । puRqrakaH 2 mallinI 3 BramarAnandA 4 kAmukakAntA 5 । tasya guRAH । kazAyatvaM । SItalatvaM । SramanASitvaM । pittadAhajvaronmAdahikvAcCarddinivArakatvaYca । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (kaRikArAn kuruvakAn campakAnatimuktakAn ॥ iti rAmAyaRe) ॥
v: tri॰ atimukta + svArTe kan । nirvARamuktimati atiSayitamukte ca । mucA BAve kta atiSayena muktaM banDahInatA yasya kap । tindukavfkze, tAlavfkze ca pu॰ ।
m: अति—मुक्तक m. = the preceding
mountain ebony
the tree Harimantha.

k.v: पारिभद्रे निम्बतरुर्मन्दारः पारिजातकः। तिनिशे स्यन्दनो नेमी रथद्रुरतिमुक्तकः॥

v: strI atyantA muktiH । videhakEvalye tattvajYAnAnantaram “tasya tAvadeva ciraM yAvat vimokzye iti” SrutidarSite SarIratyAge, atimokzAdayopyatrArTe pu॰ ।
m: अति—मुक्ति (अति.) f. final liberation (from death), TS.; ŚBr. xiv.
अति-मुक्ति f. final liberation. See अति.
(also) a partic. class of oblations, ĀpŚr.
a: अतिमुक्तिः — f. --मोक्षः Final liberation (from death).

m: अति-नामन् m. N. of a Saptarṣi of the sixth Manvantara.
अति-नाष्ट्र mfn. beyond danger, out of danger, ŚBr.
a: अतिनाष्ट्र — a. Ved. Out of danger.

m: अति-√ नी to lead over or beyond, to help a person over anything, RV. &c.; to allow to pass away: Intens. Ā. -नेनीयते, to bring forward, RV. vi, 47, 16.
अति—नीच mfn. excessively low.
अति-नौ mfn. disembarked, Pāṇ., Sch.
a: अतिनौ --नु — a. [अतिक्रांतो नावं] Disembarked, landed.

m: अति-√ नम् to bend aside, keep on one side.
(Caus. -नामयति), to pass time, Divyāv.
अति-√ नेद् to stream or flow over, foam over, TS. &c.
अति-निः-√ श्वस् to breathe or sigh violently.
अति-निचृत् (or wrongly written अति-निवृत्) f. N. of a Vedic metre of three pādas (containing respectively seven, six and seven syllables), RV.; Prāt.; RV.; Prāt. &c.
a: अतिनिचृ(वृ)त् — f. N. of a Vedic metre of 3 Pādas, the number of syllables in each being respectively 7, 6 and 7; (षट्कः सप्तकयोर्मध्ये स्तोतॄणांविवाचीति . यस्याः सातिनिवृन्नाम गायत्री द्विदशाक्षरा).

m: अति—निद्रा f. excessive sleep
a: अतिनिद्रा — Excessive sleeping. --द्र a. 1 Given to excessive sleep. --2 Without sleep, sleepless. --द्रं ind. Past sleeping time (निद्रा संप्रति न युज्यते).

v: avya॰ nidrA samprati na yujyate avyayI॰ । nidrAyA ayogyakAle । atikrAnto nidrAm atyA॰ sa॰ । atikrAntanidre nidrArahite tri॰ । atiSayitA nidrA'sya । dIrGanidre tri॰ । prA॰ sa॰ । dIrGanidrAyAM strI ।
m: अति—निद्र mfn. given to excessive sleep
अति—निद्रम् ind. See s.v. (p. 14, col. 2).
अति-निद्रम् ind. beyond sleeping time, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 6, Sch. See also अति-निद्र s.v. अति.
अति-नि-ह्नुत्य ind.p. (√ ह्नु), denying obstinately.
अति—निपुण mfn. very skilful.

a: अतिनिर्हारिन् — a. Very attractive (as an attributive of smell); आमोदःसोऽतिनिर्हारी Ak.

k.v: विमर्दोत्थे परिमलो गन्धे जनमनोहरे। आमोदः सोऽतिनिर्हारी वाच्यलिङ्गत्वमागुणात्.।

m: अति-निष्-टन् (√ तन्), (perf. Pot. 3. pl. अति-निष्-टतन्युः) to penetrate (with rays), RV. i, 141, 13.

s: tri, (kugatiprAdItisamAsaH । gostriyorupasarjanasyeti hrasvaH .) atItanOkaM । nAvamatikrAntaM । nAbottIrRRaM । ityamaraH । tasya puMstrIliNgayoH atinOH iti rUpaM ॥
v: tri॰ atikrAntonAvam atyA॰ sa॰ klIbe hrasvaH । nOkAtikramakAriRi । puMsi striyAM ca atinOH ।
m: अति-√ नु Caus. to turn away, TS.

k.v: क्लीबेऽर्धनावं नावोऽर्धेऽतीतनौकेऽतिनु त्रिषु। त्रिष्वागाधात्प्रसन्नोऽच्छः कलुषोऽनच्छ आविलः॥

m: अति-√ नुद् to drive by, AV.
अति-√ 1. पा Caus. P. -पाययति, to give to drink in great quantity, Kathās.
अति-पाद m. going too far, overstepping, TBr.
अति-पाद-निचृत् f. N. of a Vedic metre of three pādas (containing respectively six, eight and seven syllables).
a: अतिपादनिचृ(वृ)त् — f. N. of a Vedic Metre of 3 pādas, the number of syllabes in each being respectively 6, 8 and 7.

m: अति-पारय mfn. carrying across, RV. vi, 47, 7.

s: puM, (ati + pat + BAve GaY) atikramaH । upAtyayaH । paryyayaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA SAkuntale -- na cedanyakAryyAtipAtaH) ॥
v: pu॰ atikramya pAtaH gatiH ati + pata--GaY । “atikrame “na cet kAryyAtipAtaH” iti Saku॰ ।
m: अति-पात m. passing away, lapse, neglect, transgression
ill-usage, opposition, contrariety.
a: अतिपातः — 1 Passing away, lapse (of time); अहो काल˚ तः Māl. 2. --2 Neglect, omission; transgression; न चेदन्यकार्यातिपातः Ś. 1 if no other duty be neglected thereby, if it should not interfere with (the discharge of) any other duty; deviation from established laws or customs. --3 Befalling, occurrence; दुःखातिपातेन कलुषीकियंते K. 289; जलधारातिपातः 302 falling. --4 Ill-treatment, or usage. --5 Opposition, contrariety.

k.v: पर्यायश्चातिपातस्तु स्यात्पर्यय उपात्ययः। नियमो व्रतमस्त्री तच्चोपवासादि पुण्यकम्.।
स्याद्व्यत्यासो विपर्यासो व्यत्ययश्च विपर्यये। पर्ययोऽतिक्रमस्तस्मिन्नतिपात उपात्ययः॥

s: klI, (atiduzwatayA anyat pAtakaM pApamatikrAntaM prAdisamAsaH .) navaviDapApamaDye gurutarapAtakaM । tat triviGaM । puMsaH mAtfduhitfsnuzAgamanajanyaM । striyAstu putrapitfSvaSuragamanajanyaM । iti prAyaScittavivekaH ॥
v: na॰ atikrAnto'tyantaduzwatvenAnyat pAtakaM atyA॰ sa॰ । puMsAM mAtfsnuzAduhitfgamanajanye, strIRAYca puttrapitfSvaSuragamanajanye pAtakaviSeze । “mAtfgamanaM, duhitfgamanaM, snuzAgamanaYcetyatipAtakAnIti” “atipAtakinastvete praviSeyurhutASanamiti” “etezvakftaprAyaScittA atipAtakinaH paryyAyeRa kalpaM pacyante” iti ca vizRu sa॰ । “sadyo'gnipraveSanatipAtakina” iti hArItaH । “aTa narakAnuBUtaduHKAnAM tiryyaktvamuttIrRAnAM mAnuzye lakzaRAni kuzWyatipAtakIti” vizRusa॰ । pAtakamatikrAntavati puRyaSIle tri॰ ।
m: अति—पातक n. a very heinous sin.
a: अतिपातकं — A very heinous sin, incest, (मातृगमनं दुहितृगमनं स्नुषागमनं, पुंसां; पुत्रपितृश्वशुरगमनं च स्त्रीणां, अतिपातकानि उच्यंते.)

m: अति-पातिन् mfn. overtaking, excelling in speed
(in med.) running a rapid course, acute, neglecting.
a: अतिपातिन् — a. 1 Acute, running a rapid course. --2 Surpassing in speed, swifter than (in comp.); ततार विद्याः पवनातिपातिभिर्दिशो हरिद्भिर्हरितामिवेश्वरः R. 3. 30.

m: अति-पातित mfn. completely displaced or broken
अति-पातित n. (in med.) complete fracture of a bone.
a: अतिपातित — p. p. 1 Put off, delayed &c. --2 Quite or entirely broken; अस्थिनिःशेषतश्छिन्नमतिपातितम् Suśr. --तं Complete fracture of a bone.

m: अति-पात्य mfn. to be passed over, to be neglected.
a: अतिपात्य — pot. p. To be delayed or put off; काममनतिपात्यं धर्मकार्यं देवस्य Ś. 5.

m: अति-√ पॄ cl. 4. P. -पूर्यति, to become full or overflowing, MBh.

अति-√ पू P. to clarify or purify through (3. pl. aor. अति अपाविषुः), RV. ix, 60, 2 : Ā. -पवते, to purify or purge by flowing through (especially used of the Soma juice, which is considered to be a purgative), ŚBr. &c.
अति—पूत mfn. quite purified, over-refined.

a: अतिपंचा — [पंचवर्षमतिक्रांता] A girl past five.

m: अति-√ पश् to look beyond, look through, RV. i, 94, 7; AV.

v: pu॰ atiSayitaH sundaraH panTAH prA॰ sa॰ ateH pUjArTatvAt na samA॰ । satpaTe । atItapaTe tu samA॰ ।
m: अति—पथिन् (nom. -पन्थास्) m. a better road than common, L.
a: अतिपथिन् — m. A better road than common, a good road.

k.v: अतिपन्थाः सुपन्थाश्च सत्पथश्चार्चितेऽध्वनि। व्यध्वो दुरध्वो विपथः कदध्वा कापथः समाः॥

m: अति-√ पठ् Pass. -पथ्यते, to be greatly proclaimed or celebrated, MBh.
अति-पञ्चा f. a girl who is past five.
अति-√ पद् to go beyond (acc.), jump over; to neglect, transgress: Caus. -पादयति to allow to pass by.
a: अतिपद् — {c4c} A. 1 To go beyond; spring over. --2 To neglect, omit, transgress. --Caus. To allow to pass by.

v: tri॰ atikrAntaH padaM caraRam । varRavfttAnusAripAdAtikrAnte “atipadA gAyatrI atipadA jagatIti” ।
m: अति—पद mfn. (in prosody) too long by one पद or foot,
a: अतिपद — a. [अतिक्रांतः पदं] 1 Having no feet. --2 Too long by one foot.

s: [n] puM, (atyutkfzwaH panTAH karmmaDArayaH । ateH pUjArTatvAnna samAsAntapratyayaH .) sanmArgaH । supaTaH । ityamaraH ॥

m: अति-पन्न mfn. gone beyond, transgressed, missed
past.
a: अतिपन्न — p. p. Gone beyond, transgressed, missed, past &c.

m: अति-परी (परि-√ इ), to pass round, ĀpŚr.
अति-पर mfn. one who has overcome his enemies
अति-पर m. a great enemy.
a: अतिपर — a. One who has vanquished his enemies. --रः A great or superior enemy.
अतिपरिचयः — Excessive familiarity or intimacy; Prov. अतिपरिचयादवज्ञा ‘Familiarity breeds contempt.’

v: tri॰ atikrAntam parokzam । pratyakze, tadvizaye ca ।
m: अति—परोक्ष mfn. far out of sight, no longer discernible.
a: अतिपरोक्ष — a. 1 Far out of sight, not discernible; ˚वृत्ति obsolete (words). --2 Not hidden, visible.

m: अति—परोक्ष-वृत्ति mfn. (in Gr.) having a nature that is no longer discernible i.e. obsolete.
अति-√ पत् to fall or fly by or past or beyond or over, to neglect, miss: Caus. -पातयति, to cause to fly by, to drag away, to make effectless.
a: अतिपत् — {c1c} P. 1 To pass over; neglect, omit, transgress. --2 To fly by, beyond, or over; to cross --Caus. 1 To delay, neglect; see अतिपात्य below. --2 To disrespect, offend; ये सत्यमेव हि गुरूनतिपातयंति Mu. 3. 34 transgress, violate; अतिपातितकालसाधना Ki. 2. 42. --3 To cause to fly past or by. --4 To make ineffectual; संशमनमेवं संशोधनमतिपातयति Suśr. --5 To snatch away, drag away.

s: klI, (ati + pat + BAve lyuw) atyayaH । atikramaRaM । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: अति-पतन n. act of falling or flying beyond, passing, missing, transgressing.
a: अतिपतनं — Flying past or beyond; omission, neglect, missing, transgressing; exceeding, going beyond due bounds.

m: अति-पतित mfn. passed beyond, transgressed, missed.

s: puM, (ativfhat patraM yasya saH bahuvrIhiH .) hastikandavfkzaH । SAkavfkzaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
a: अतिपत्रः — [अतिरिक्तं बृहत् पत्रं यस्य] The teak tree, or the हस्तिकंदवृक्ष.

v: strI ati + pata--ktin । atipatane, atikrame । “kAlAtipattO dviguRAmiti” smftiH । padaktin pattirnizpattiH atyA॰ sa॰ । anizpattO strI । “liNnimitte lfN kriyAtipattAviti” pA॰ । kriyAtipattiH kriyAyA anizpattiriti vfttiH । pattiM senAmatikrAnte tri॰ ।
m: अति-पत्ति f. going beyond, passing, lapse
क्रियातिपत्ति, the passing by of an action unaccomplished, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 139.
a: अतिपत्तिः — f. 1 Going beyond, passing, lapse; देशकालातिपत्तौ च गृहीत्वा स्वयमर्पयेत् Y. 2. 169. --2 Non-performance, failure; लिङ्निमित्ते ऌङ् क्रियातिपत्तौ P. III. 3. 139 (the conditional is used instead of the potential, when the non-performance of an action is implied). --3 [पत्तिं अतिक्रांतः] One surpassing a footsoldier.

m: अति-पत्त्र m. the Teak tree
the tree Hastikanda.
अति-पटीक्षेप v.l. for अ-पटीक्षेप m. omitting to remove or non-removal of the theatrical curtain.
अति—पेशल mfn. very dexterous.
अति-√ 1. पृ to convey across, to help over, RV.; to cross, pass over, RV. i, 174, 9 and vi, 20, 12; to keep (a promise) : Caus. -पारयति to lead or convey over, RV. &c.
अति-पितामह m. surpassing his own paternal grandfather, ŚBr. xiv.
अति-पितृ m. surpassing his own father, ŚBr. xiv.
अति-प्राणम् ind. exceeding life.
अति-प्राण-प्रिय mfn. dearer than life.

v: strI prakarzeRa uhyate'tra prOQaH vivAhakAlaH prA॰ ba॰ atiSayitA vA prOQA vfdDiyuktA । vivAhayogyakAlAyAm atiSayavfdDiyuktAyAYca striyAm strIRAntu daSavarzAtItakAla eva atiprOQakAlaH । “atiprOQA ca yA nArIti” smftiH atipravfdDe tri॰ ।
a: {{अतिप्राढा->अतिप्रौढा||20170110||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्332,|}} — A girl who has attained a marriageable age, a grown-up girl.

m: अति—प्रौढ mfn. full-grown.
अति—प्रौढ-यौवन mfn. being in the full enjoyment of youth.
अति-√ प्रछ् to go on asking, ŚBr. &c.
अति-प्र-णी (√ नी) to lead by or beyond, Lāṭy.; ĀśvŚr.
अति-प्र-णश् (√ 2. नश्), to be entirely deprived of (acc.), ŚBr.
अति—प्रणय m. excessive kindness, partiality.
अति-प्र-णुद् (√ नुद्) to press or incite very strongly.
अति—प्रणुद्य ind. having pushed far forward.
अति-प्र-√ शंस् to praise highly.
अति-प्र-√ शृध् (Caus. -शर्धयति), to obtrude or force anything upon any one (dat.), RV. viii, 13, 6.

v: pu॰ atikramya maryyAdAM praSnaH । maryyAdAtikrameRa praSne saduttare jAte'pi punarjijYAsAyAm । yaTA bfhadAraRyake yAjYavalkyaM prati bAlAkyatipraSnaH tatra brahmamImAMsAyAm tena kftAyAmapi vfTAtipraSnakaraRAt tasya muRqapatanaM sUryyavarAt jAtamiti bfhadAraRyake'nusanDeyam ।
m: अति—प्रश्न m. an extravagant question, a question regarding transcendental objects.
a: अतिप्रश्नः — [अतिक्रम्य मर्यादां प्रश्नः] A question about transcendental truths; a vexatious or extravagant question that is asked though a satisfactory reply has already been given; e. g. Bālāki's question to Yājñavalkya about Brahma in बृहदारण्यकोपनिषद्.

m: अति—प्रश्न्य mfn. to be asked such a question, BṛĀrUp.
अति-प्र-√ श्रु cl. 5. Ā. -शृण्वे (Ved. 3. sg.), to become known or famous more than others, RV. x, 11, 7.

a: अतिप्रबंधः — Great continuity; ˚प्रहितास्त्रवृष्टिभिः R. 3. 58 very rapidly or in rapid succession.

m: अति—प्रबन्ध m. complete continuity.
अति-प्र-√ चित् -चेकिते (= -चिकिते, BR.; = Intens. -चेकित्ते, Gmn.), to be clearly distinct or distinguishable, RV. i, 55, 3.
अति-प्र-√ च्यु to pass by, TBr. : Caus. -च्यावयति, to cause to pass by, ŚBr.

v: avya॰ atipragIyate'smin kAle ati + pra + gE--ke । atyantaprAtaHkAle । “nAtiprage nAtisAyaM na niSITe na cozasIti” smftiH ।
m: अति—प्रगे ind. very early, Mn.
a: अतिप्रगे — ind. Very early in the morning, in the early dawn Ms. 4. 62.

m: अति-प्र-√ हा cl. 3. Ā. -जिहीते, to give or hand over, ŚBr.
अति-प्र-√ ज्वल् to flame or blaze exceedingly, MBh.
अति—प्रकाश mfn. very notorious.

v: tri॰ atikrAntaH pramARam atyA॰ sa॰ । pramARAtikrAnte yasya yatpramARamucitaM tato'DikapramARavati । prA॰ sa॰ । atyantapramARe bfhatpramARe na॰ ।
m: अति-प्रमाण mfn. beyond measure, immense.
अति-प्र-√ पद् Caus. -पादयति, to help to pass into the other world (Comm.), MBh. iv, 1717.
अति-प्र-√ स्था to have an advantage over, RV. i, 64, 13 and viii, 60, 16.

a: अतिप्रसंगः, --प्रसक्तिः — f. 1 Excessive attachment; नातिप्रसंगः प्रमदासुकार्यः Pt. 1. 187; स्त्रीष्वतिप्रसंगात् Dk. 101. --2 Over-rudeness, impertinence; तद्विरमातिप्रसंगात् U. 5; मा भूत्पुनर्बत कथंचिदतिप्रसंगः Mv. 3. 16 indiscretion or imprudence; यदेतावतः परिभवातिप्रसंगस्य तुल्यं स्यात् Mv. 5 an insult. --3 Extraordinary or unwarrantable stretch of a (grammatical) rule, or principle; also = अतिव्याप्ति q. v. --4 A very close contact; अतिप्रसंगाद्विहितागसो मुहुः Ki. 8. 33 (अविच्छेदसंग). --5 Prolixity; अलमतिप्रसंगेन Mu. 1.

v: pu॰ ati + pra + sanja GaY । atiprasaktipadArTe । prasaNgamatikrAntavati tri॰ ।
m: (also) too much diffuseness, Veṇīs.; Rājat.
अति-प्र-√ सद् P. -सिदति, to become completely cheerful.

v: strI ati + pra + sanja--ktin । atyantAsaktO, prasaNgamatikramyAnyatra sambanDe atiprasaNge ca । lakzyelakzaRasambanDaH prasaNgaH, alakzye tatsambanDo'tiprasaNgaH । “atiprasaktyanApAdaketi” jagadISaH ।
m: अति—प्रसक्ति, f. or अति—प्रसङ्ग, m. excessive attachment unwarrantable stretch of a rule.
अति-प्रसन्न n. (impers.) too much grace has been shown, Mālatīm.
अति-प्र-√ सृ Intens. -सर्सृते, to outstrip, surpass, RV. ii, 25, 1.
अति-प्र-सृत mfn. issued violently.

v: tri॰ ati + pra + siDa--kta । ativiKyAte suBUzite ca ।
m: अति—प्रसिद्ध mfn. very notorious.
अति-प्र-√ 2. वा cl. 4. P. -वायति, to blow violently, MBh.
अति-प्र-√ वह् to extend or carry beyond.
अति—प्रवरण n. excess in choosing.
अति-प्र-√ वे to add in weaving, weave on an additional piece, ŚāṅkhBr.

v: tri॰ atyantaM pramARAtirekeRa pravfdDam । pramARAtirekeRa vfdDimati । atipravfdDiSca nadyAderjalasya tIrAdyatikrameRa, kzattriyAdeH svakarttavyatAmUQatayA maryyAdAdyatikrameRa vIryyADikyena vA vfdDiH “tasyAtipravfdDasya brAhmaRAn prati anAdara” iti । “atipravfdDaM prahitAstravfzwiBiriti” raGuH ।
m: अति—प्रवृद्ध mfn. enlarged to excess, overbearing, Mn.
a: अतिप्रवृद्ध — a. 1 Overbearing Ms. 9. 320. --2 Grown very much.

m: अति-प्र-√ वृत् to issue violently (as blood from a wound), Suśr.; to have an intense effect (as venom), Suśr.
अति—प्रवृत्ति f. issuing abundantly.
अति-प्र-विद्ध mfn. (√ व्यध्), frightened away, scared, R.
अति-प्र-√ यम् to give or hand over, TS.; TBr.
अति-प्र-√ युज् to separate from (with instr.), TS.
अति-प्रेषित n. the time following the Praiṣa ceremony, KātyŚr.
a: अतिप्रेषितं — The time after the ceremony in which the प्रैष Mantras are used.

m: अति-√ प्रु to jump over, to escape, TS.
अति—पुरुष or अति—पूरुष (अति-) [ŚBr.], m. a first-rate man, hero.

s: klI, (qI + BAve ktaH tasya naH । atyanta qInaM gamanaM karmmaDArayaH .) pakziRAM pracaRqagamanaM । iti mahABArataM ॥
v: na॰ atikrAntaM qInaM gatiBedaM atyA॰ sa॰ । pakziRAm atidIrGagamane ।
m: अति—डीन n. extraordinary flight (of birds), MBh.
a: अतिडीनं — Extraordinary flight (of birds).

m: अति-√ राज् to shine over (aor. Subj. 3. sg. अति राट्), RV. vi, 12, 5.
अति-राज्ञी f. (a woman) superior to a king, ib.

v: tri॰ atikrAnto rAjAnam wac samA॰ । atikrAntanfpe । striyAM NIp ।

m: अति-राजकुमारि mfn. superior to a princess, Pāṇ. i, 2, 48, Sch.

v: pu॰ atiSayitaH pUjito rAjA “na pUjanAditi nizeDAt na wac । pUjyanfpatO ।
m: अति—राजन् m. an extraordinary king, Pāṇ. v, 4, 69, Sch.
one who surpasses a king [cf. also s.v.]
अति-राजन् m. a supreme king, superior to a king, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 12, Sch.
a: अतिराजन् — m. 1 An extraordinary or excellent king. --2 One who surpasses a king.

m: अतिराजय Nom. P. अतिराजयति, to surpass a king, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 2, Sch.

v: pu॰ atiSayitA rAtriH tataH astyarTe ac । ekarAtrasADye yAgaBede । sa ca gavAmayane praTamasaMsTaH yaToktaM tARqyabrAhmaRe । “prajApatirvA idamagra AsIt so'kAmayata bahu syAM prajAyeyeti saetamatirAtramapaSyattamAharattenAhorAtre prAjanayaditi” gavAmamayanasatramupakramya, “aTAsya satrasya pUrvvoktAnyahAni krameRa viDAsyan atirAtrasaMsTam praTamaM viDAtumAheti” BAzye avataraRikAM dattvA vyAKyAtaM yaTA “sa evaM kAmayamAnaH prajApatiH sfzwyupAyatvena etaM gavAmayanasyAdyamatirAtramapaSyaditi” । taYca stutipUrvvakaM viDitsannAha । “yadezo'trirAtro sa evAhorAtre eva prajanayantIti” “eza prajApatinA dfzwo'tirAtraH gavAmayanasya praTamamaharBavatIti yat tena satrAnanutizWanto yajamAnA ahorAtre eva prajanayanti utpAdayanti svADIne kurvvantIti” BAzyam । itTamupakramya caturTADyAyapraTamaKaRqaparyyante tatra vihitAni stotraSastrAdInyuktAni । “atirAtre zoqaSinaM gfhRAti, nAtirAtre zoqaSinaM gfhRAtIti” Srutyantaram । zoqaSI pAtraBedaH ।
m: अति-रात्र mfn. prepared or performed over-night, RV. vii, 103, 7
अति-रात्र m. an optional part of the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice
commencement and conclusion of certain sacrificial acts
the concluding Vedic verse chanted on such occasions, AV. &c.
N. of a son of Cākṣuṣa the sixth Manu.
a: अतिरात्र — a. Ved. [अतिक्रांतो रात्रिं] Prepared over-night. --त्रः [ अतिशयिता रात्रिः, ततः अस्त्यर्थे अच्] 1 An optional part of the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice (एकरात्रसाध्यगवामयने प्रथमसंस्थः यागभेदः). --2 Dead of night.

m: अति-रात्र—सवनीय-पशु m. the victim sacrificed at the Atirātra.
अति-रात्र-याजिन् m. N. of a dramatic author (of the 16th century, A.D.).
अति-रै exceeding one's income, extravagant, Pāṇ., Sch.
a: अतिरै — a. (रि n.) Exceeding one's income, extravagant.

v: tri॰ atiSayitaH rUkzaH prA॰ sa॰ । atyantarUkze snehaSUnye ca । taTABUte kaNgukodravAdiDAnye pu॰ । atikrAntorUkzam । atiSayasnigDe tri॰ ।
a: अतिरूक्ष — a. 1 Very rough or barren; devoid of affection, cruel. --2 Very affectionate [अतिक्रांतो रूक्षं]. --क्षः N. of a variety of grain.

v: pu॰ atikrAnto rUpam । rUpavarjjite parameSvare । “aSabdamasparSamarUpamavyayamiti” SrutyA tasya rUpahInatApratipAdanAttaTAtvam । SuklAdirUpahIne vAyvAdO tri॰ । atiSayitaM rUpam prA॰ sa॰ । sundararUpe na॰ । “atirUpavatI kanyA” ।
m: अति—रूप mfn. very beautiful
अति—रूप n. extraordinary beauty.
a: अतिरूप — a. 1 Formless, such as wind. --2 Very beautiful. --पं Great beauty; as ˚वती कन्या. --पः [ अतिक्रांतो रूपं] the Supreme Being.

m: अति—रभस m. extraordinary speed.
a: अतिरभसः — Great speed, precipitateness, headlong speed, rashness; ˚कृतानां कर्मणां Bh. 2. 99; दर्शन˚ प्रधावितेन K. 192 great hurry.

m: अति—रंहस् mfn. extremely rapid, Śāk.
a: अतिरंहस् — a. Very fleet or swift; सारंगेणातिरंहसा Ś. 1. 5.

v: pu॰ atikrAnto raTaM raTinam atyA॰ sa॰ । “amitAn yoDayedyastu saMprokto'tiraTastu sa” ityuktalakzaRe yoDaviSeze । “ye raTAH pfTivIpAla! taTEvAtiraTASca ye” ityupakramya “kftavarmmA hyatiraTa” iti “madrarAjo mahezvAsaH Salyo me'tiraTo mata” ityAdinA bahavo'tiraTA BA॰ udyo॰ raTAtiraTAsaMKyAne darSitAH । raTAtikramakArake tri॰ ।
m: अति—रथ m. a great warrior (fighting from a car), R.
a: अतिरथः — [अतिक्रांतो रथं रथिनं] An unrivalled warrior, fighting from his car (अमितान् योधयेद्यस्तु संप्रोक्तोऽ तिरथस्तु सः); दत्त्वाऽभयं सोतिरथः Ve. 3. 26. Several Atirathas are mentioned in Bhārata Udyogaparvan.

m: अति—रक्ता f. one of Agni's seven tongues.

v: tri॰ atyantaH raktaH raktavarRaH anurAgayukto vA । atilohitavarRe, atyantAnurakte ca । atyantaraktavarRe pu॰ ।
m: अति—रक्त mfn. very red
a: अतिरक्त — a. Very red or very much attached. --क्ता N. of one of the 7 tongues of Agni.

s: strI, atyanto raso yasyAH sA .) mUrvvAlatA । rAsnA । klItanakaM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI atiSayito raso yasyAH ba॰ । (rAsnA) iti KyAtAyAM mUrvvAlatAyAm ।
m: अति—रसा f. ‘very succulent’, N. of various plants (Mūrvā, Rāsnā, Klītanaka).
a: अतिरसा — (Very juicy) N. of various plants, मूर्वा, रास्ना and क्लीतनक.

s: tri, (ati ric + BAve GaY । ADikye SrezWatve ca .) atiSayaH । yaTA, -- “sampUrRe tUBayorjYeyamatireke pare'hani” । iti tiTyAditattvaM ॥
v: pu॰ ati + ric--GaY । atiSaye, Bede, prADAnye, ADikye ca । “saMpUrRametayorjYeyamatireke pare'hanIti” tiTita॰ ।
m: अति-रेक or अती-रेक [only once, ŚBr.], अस्, m. surplus, excess redundancy; difference.
a: अति(ती)रेकः — [रिच्-घञ्] 1 Excess, exuberance, excellence, eminence; पौरुषातिरेकः U. 6; so मद˚, वीर्य˚, गुण˚ &c. --2 Redundancy, surplus, superfluity. --3 Difference.

m: अति-रेकिन् mfn. surpassing.

v: na॰ atikrAntaM rAyaM klIbatvAt hrasvaH । DanAtikrAnte kulAdO । tftIyAdyaci tu atiriRA atiriRe ityevamekEkameva rUpaM, na puMvadBAvaH tasya igantANgatvABAvAt । puMsi, striyAYca atirAH atirAyAvityAdi ।
m: अति-रि neut. of अति-रै, q.v.

अति-√ रिच् Pass. -रिच्यते, to be left with a surplus, to surpass (in a good or bad sense with abl. or acc.); to be superior, predominate, prevail: Caus. -रेचयति, to do superfluously, to do too much, ŚBr. &c.
a: अतिरिच् — (Gen. used in pass.) 1 To surpass, excel, be superior to (with abl.); अश्वमेधसहस्रेभ्यः सत्यमेवातिरिच्यते H. 4. 131; गृहं तु गृहिणीहीनं कांतारादतिरिच्यते Pt. 4. 81; वाचः कर्मातिरिच्यते ‘example is better than precept;’ sometimes with acc.; न च नारायणोऽत्रभवंतमतिरिच्यते K. 203; or used by itself in the sense of ‘to be supreme,’ ‘prevail’, ‘triumph’, ‘predominate’, ‘be mightier’; न किंचिदतिरिच्यते Ms. 9. 296 none is supreme or higher than another; 12. 25; so दैवमत्रातिरिच्यते, स्वभावोतिरिच्यते H. 1. 17; स्वल्पमप्यतिरिच्यते H. 2 is of great importance. --2 To be left with a surplus, be redundant or superfluous.

m: अतिरिक्ताङ्ग mfn. having a redundant limb or finger or toe
अतिरिक्ताङ्ग n. a redundant limb or finger or toe.

s: tri, (ati ric + karttari ktaH । SrezWe Binne SUnye ca । BAve ktaH, atireke ADikye ca .) aDikaH । atiSayitaH । tatparyyAyaH । samaDikaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥
v: tri॰ ati + ric--kta । atiSayite, SrezWe, Binne, SUnye ca । BAve kta । atiSaye, ADikye ca na॰ । tatra Bede “atiriktamaTApi yadBavediti” BAzA॰ “na vfkzavftti vyatirikteti” kumA॰ । yasya yAvatpramARaM yuktaM tato'Dikatve “hInANgImatiriktANgImiti” smftiH ।
m: अति-रिक्त mfn. left with or as a surplus, left apart
redundant, unequalled
different from (with abl.)
a: अतिरिक्त — p. p. 1 Surpassed, excelled; सर्वातिरिक्तसारेण R. 1. 14 strength exceeding that of all creatures; सुतजन्मातिरिक्तेन महोत्सवेन K. 137 surpassing the birth of a son. --2 Redundant, superfluous, remaining over and above; परिपूरितहृदयातिरिक्तहर्षमिव K. 66 not contained in the heart. --3 Excessive, exuberant. --4 Unequalled, unsurpassed; supreme, elevated; समश्नुवानाः सहसाऽतिरिक्ततां Ki. 14. 33 being raised up or elevated. --5 Different (generally व्यतिरिक्त in this sense, q. v.). --6 Quite empty. --Comp. --अंग a. having a redundant limb (a finger, toe &c.). --(गं) a redundant limb or member.

k.v: चञ्चलं तरलं च एव पारिप्लवपरिप्लवे। अतिरिक्तः समधिको धृढसन्धिस्तु संहतः॥

m: अति-रिक्त—ता f. redundancy, &c.

v: na॰ na tiroDAnam । prakASe, vyavaDAnABAve ca ।

m: अति—रोग m. consumption, L.
a: अतिरोगः — Consumption.

v: tri॰ na tirohitaH । prakASite sPuwe'rTe “atirohitArTamanyaditi” pramitA॰ । avyavahite ca ।

m: अति-रोक m. a passage for light, vista, MaitrS.

v: pu॰ atiSayitaM roma atiroman + astyarTe Sa । vanajAte CAge, bfhadvAnare ca । atyantaromAQye tri॰ ।

अति—रोमश m. a wild goat, a kind of monkey.
a: अति-लो-रोमश — a. Very hairy, shaggy. --शः 1 A wild goat. --2 A large monkey. --शा A potherb (नीलबुह्ना) Convolvulus Argenteus.

v: pu॰ rocate iti ruk strIRAmUrudeSaH atikrAnto rucam atyA॰ sa॰ । jAnudeSe । atikrAntakAntike tri॰ । prA॰ sa॰ । atiSayitakAntO strI ।
m: 1. अति-√ रुच् to shine over or along, RV. &c.; to surpass in shining.
2. अति-रुच् m. a horse's fetlock or knee, VS.
a: अतिरुच् — m. [रोचते इति रुक् स्त्रीणां ऊरुदेशः; अतिक्रांतो रुचं Tv.] The knee. --क् f. A very beautiful woman.

m: अति—रुचिरा f. N. of two metres (a variety of the अतिजगती; another called चुडिका or चुलिका).
अति—रुचिर mfn. very lovely
a: अतिरुचिर — a. Very lovely. --रा N. of two metres, the one a variety of अतिजगती, and the other also called चूडिका or चूलिका.

m: अति-√ रुह् to climb or ascend over, RV. ix, 17, 5; to grow higher, RV. x, 90, 2.
अति—रुष् mfn. very angry.
अति—साध्वस n. excessive fear.

a: अतिसांतपनं — A kind of very austere penance; ( गोमूत्रगोमयक्षीरदधिसर्पिःकुशोदकान्येकाहं द्वितीयमुपवसेत्तत्सांतपनं; त्र्यहाभ्यस्तैश्चातिसांतपनं Viṣṇu Smṛti).

m: अति-सांवत्सर mfn. extending over more than a year, Mn.
a: अतिसांवत्सर — a. (री f.) Extending over more than a year; Ms. 8. 153.

a: अतिसाम्या — [अत्यंतं साम्यं मधुना अस्याः] N. of the plant मधुयष्टि, sweet juice of the Bengal Madder, Rubia Manjith.

a: अतिवाहकः — [अतीत्य एतं देहं बाहयति देहांतरं प्रापयति; वह्-ण्वुल्] The deity or spirit appointed by God to help in the conveying of the जीव or सूक्ष्मशरीर in the above manner.

अति-वाहन n. excessive toiling or enduring.

a: अतिवाहिक — a. [अतिवाहोस्त्यस्य ठन्] Able to convey to other bodies, See अतिवाह.

a: अतिवह् — {c1c} P. To carry over or across. --Caus. 1 To spend, pass (as time); किं वा मयापि न दिनान्यतिवाहितानि Māl. 6. 13; अतिवाहयांबभूव त्रियामां R. 9. 70; ऋतून् 19. 47. --2 To let pass over, get through successfully; गुहाविसारीण्यतिवाहितानि मया कथंचिद्घनगर्जितानि R. 13. 28 allowed to pass over my head, endured; स शापस्तेनातिवाहितः Ks. 33. 91. --3 To rid oneself of, elude, avoid; अस्मिंस्तमालविटपांधकारे प्रविश्य एनमतिवाहयावः Ratn. 2 get out of his way, elude his pursuit (and thus cheat him). --4 To transplant, remove (to another place), bring or carry over; अलकामतिवाह्यैव वसतिं वसुसंपदां Ku. 6. 37. --5 To follow, tread (as a path); लोकातिवाहिते मार्गे Sarva.

a: अतिवृत् — {c1c} A. (P. in epic poetry). 1 To pass over or by, cross (as a place &c.). --2 (a) To go beyond, exceed (fig. also); वाग्विभवातिवृत्तं आचार्यकं Māl. 1. 26 exceeding or transcending the powers of speech, indescribable; मुकुलावस्थामतिवृत्तेषु तंडुलेषु Dk. 132; का ते स्तुतिः स्तुतिपथादतिवृत्तधाम्नः Mv. 4. 29 transcending praise. (b) To offend, overstep, transgress, violate; योस्याः शासनमतिवर्तते Dk. 167; कोतिवर्तते दैवं 51 who can transgress the decrees of Fate? कोन्यो जीवितुकामो देवस्य शासनमतिवर्तेत Mu. 3, Śi. 6. 19. (c) To neglect, omit, let slip. (d) To have no regard to, disregard, slight; offend (especially by unfaithfulness), injure; शपथशतातिवर्ती Dk. 62 disregarding; ऋतुस्नातां सतीं भार्यां… अतिवर्तेत दुष्टात्मा; यथाहं कर्मणावाचा शरीरेण च राघवं . सततं नातिवर्तेय Rām.; अपत्यलोभाद्यातु स्त्रीभर्तारमतिवर्तते Ms. 5. 161. --3 (a) To surpass, excel; मनुष्यसंख्यामतिवर्तितुं वा Ki. 3. 40, Śi. 14. 59; बांधवस्नेहं राज्यलोभोऽतिवर्तते Ks. 41. 40 to outweigh, preponderate. (b) To overcome, subdue, vanquish, get the better of; get over, escape or get loose from; असाध्यानतिवर्तंते प्रमेहा रजनीं यथा Suśr.; किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन् गुणानतिवर्तते Bg. 14. 21 transcend these three qualities; दैवं पौरुषेण Mb., Dk. 73, Ks. 121. 67. --4 (Intrans.) To pass away, glide away, elapse (as time); to be late or delay; एवं तयोः प्रत्यहमन्योन्याहारादिदानेन कालोतिवर्तते H. 1; महता स्नेहेन कालोतिवर्तते H. 2; समयो नातिवर्तते Mv. 6; आ षोडशाद्ब्राह्मणस्य सावित्री नातिवर्तते Ms. 2. 38 is not late (नातिक्रांतकाला भवति). --5 To go away from, leave, abandon (abl.); यथा एम् हृदयं नित्यं नातिवर्तति राघवात् Rām. --Caus. 1 To slight, not to heed, disregard; सुहृदश्चातिवर्तिताः Dk. 136. --2 To let out, discharge (as excrement).

a: अत्र — (अत्रा Ved.) ind. [अस्मिन् एतस्मिन् वा, इदं-एतद्वा सप्तम्याः त्रल् प्रकृतेः अश्भावश्च Tv.] 1 In this place, here; अपि संनिहितोऽत्र कुलपतिः Ś. 1.; अत्र गृह्यते अत्र गृह्यते K. 119 here-here i. e. just now. --2 In this respect, matter, or case; as to this, (serving the purpose of अस्मिन् विषये or of the forms अस्मिन् or एतस्मिन्, अस्यां &c. with a substantive or adjectival force); अहिंसा परमो धर्म इत्यत्र ऐकमत्यं H. 1; अलं प्रयत्नेन तवात्र R. 3. 50; भवंतमेवात्र गुरुलाघवं पृच्छामि Ś. 5; तदत्र परिगतार्थं कृत्वा Ś. 6 informing him of this matter. --3 There, in that direction. --4 Then, at that time (Ved.); कः कोत्र भोः who is there? which of the servants is in attendance? who waits there? (used in calling out to one's servants &c.; cf. Hindustāni ko hai). --Comp. --अंतरे adv. in the mean while, meantime Ś. 3. 11. --दघ्न a. (घ्नी f.) reaching so far up; as tall as this. --भवत् (m. भवान्) an honorific epithet meaning ‘worthy’, ‘revered’, ‘honourable’, ‘your or his honour’, and referring to a person that is present or near the speaker, (opp. तत्रभवत्); ˚भवती f. ‘your or her ladyship’ ( पूज्ये तत्रभवानत्रभवांश्च भगवानपि); अत्रभवान् प्रकृतिमापन्नः Ś. 2; वृक्षसेचनादेव परिश्रांतामत्रभवतीं लक्षये Ś. 1.

a: अत्रि — a. [properly अत्त्रि, Uṇ. 4. 68, अदेस्त्रिनिश्च, अद्-त्रिन्] Devourer; Rv. 2. 8. 5. --त्रिः N. of a celebrated sage and author of many Vedic hymns. [He appears in the Vedas in hymns addressed to Agni, Indra, the Aśvins and the Viśvedevas. In the Svāyambhuva Manvantara he appears as one of the ten Prajāpatis or mind-born sons of Brahmā, being born from his eye. These sons having died by the curse of Śiva, Brahmā performed a sacrifice, at the beginning of the present Vaivasvata Manvantara, and Atri was born from the flames of Agni. Anasūyā was his wife in both lives. In the first she bore him three sons, Datta, Durvāsas and Soma; in the second she had two additional children, a son by name Aryaman and a daughter called Amalā. In the Rāmāyaṇa an account is given of the visit paid by Rāma and Sītā to Atri and Anasūyā in their hermitage, when they both received them most kindly; See Anasūyā. As a Ṛṣi or sage he is one of the seven sages who were all sons of Brahmā, and represents in Astronomy one of the stars of the Great Bear situated in the north. He is also the author of a code of laws known as अत्रिस्मृति or अत्रिसंहिता. In the Purāṇas he is said to have produced the moon from his eye, while he was practising austere penance, the moon being in consequence called अत्रिज, --जात, --दृग्ज, अत्रिनेत्रप्रसूत, --˚प्रभव, ˚भव &c.; cf. also अथ नयनसमुत्थं ज्योतिरत्रेरिव द्यौः R. 2. 75 and अत्रेरिवेंदुः V. 5. 21.] --(pl.) descendants of Atri.

अत्यंत — a. [अतिक्रांतः अंतं सीमां नाशं] 1 Excessive, much, very great or strong; ˚वैरं great enmity; ˚मैत्री; ˚हिमोत्किरानिलाः Ku. 5. 26. --2 Complete, perfect, absolute; ˚अभावः absolute non-existence; See below. --3 Endless, perpetual, permanent, everlasting, uninterrupted, unbroken; किं वा तवात्यंतवियोगमोघे हतजीविते R. 14. 65; भवत्यजरमत्यंतं Pt. 1. 151; ˚तं सुखमश्नुते Ms. 5. 46; Bg. 6. 28; कस्यात्यंतं सुखमुपनतं Me. 109; नायमत्यंतसंवासो लभ्यते येन केनचित् H. 4. 73. --तं ind. 1 Exceedingly, excessively, very much, to the highest degree; स्थायीभवति चात्यंतं रागः शुक्लपटे यथा Pt. 1. 33; ˚शिशु Mu. 4. 14 very young. --2 For ever, to the end (of life), through life; अत्यंतमात्मसदृशेक्षणवल्लभाभिराहो निवत्स्यति Ś. 1. 27 for all time, in perpetuity; सा चात्यंतमदर्शनं नयनयोर्याता V. 4. 2.; oft in comp.; ˚गता See below; प्रियमत्यंतविलुप्तदर्शनं Ku. 4. 2 for ever lost to view; R. 14. 49. --3 Absolutely, perfectly, completely. --Comp. --अभावः absolute or complete non-existence, absolute non-entity, a thing which does not exist at any one of the three periods of time, or does not exist for all time; त्रैकालिकसंसर्गावच्छिन्नप्रतियोगिकः. (This is considered to be नित्य or eternal and different from the other kinds of अभाव). --ग a. going or walking too much or too fast. --गत a. gone or departed for ever, gone never to return; कथमत्यंतगता न मां दहेः R. 8. 56. {2} always applicable, perfectly intimate or pertinent. --गतिः f. {1} sense of ‘completely’; अनत्यंतगतौ क्तात् P. V. 4. 4. {2} completion, accomplishment. --गामिन् a. {1} going or walking very much, going too fast or quickly. {2} excessive, much. --निवृत्तिः f. complete disappearance, absolute cessation. --वासिन् m. [वस्-णिनि] one who constantly stays with his preceptor, as a student. --संयोगः close proximity, uninterrupted continuity; कालाध्वनोरत्यंतसंयोगे P. II. 1. 29. {2} Inseparable coexistence. --संपर्कः excessive sexual intercourse. --सुकुमार a. very tender. --(रः) a kind of grain.

अत्यंतिक — a. [अत्यंतं गच्छति; अत्यंतठन्] 1 Going too much or too fast. --2 Very near. --3 Not near, distant. --कं [अतिशयितं अंतिकं नैकट्यं] 1 Close proximity, immediate neighbourhood or being in close proximity. --2 [अतिक्रांतं अंतिकं] Great distance.
